text:
maddie: Heads up — Omniship is ready to run a 10-day joint pilot. They want Dedicated with VPC peering, SSO (SAML2), and a 99.9% latency SLA. Need a technical runbook and a pricing/PS quote.
raj: Do they require data residency?
elena: EU-only, Dedicated is fine. No on-prem.
claire: Security asked for RSA-signed SAML cert and vendor ISA + a brief token retention statement.
tom: For 150 rps sustained at peak, estimate 5 gpus steady, allow burst to 7. Drafted a ballpark cost.
maddie: Network details? open ports/IPs?
claire: Allow outbound to our telemetry endpoints + S3. IP ranges: 52.200.0.0/16, 34.210.0.0/16. Control plane TCP/443.
raj: We'll send SAML metadata. ACS: https://dedicated-<tenant>.redwood/api/saml/acs. We prefer signed assertions.
elena: They want to see KMS key rotation and HSM usage. Can we produce an architecture sketch?
tom: Yes — enable customer-managed KMS-HSM for Dedicated. I'll attach diagram.
claire: ISA answers ready; flagged questions about KV cache and prompt retention.
raj: KV cache ephemeral, no prompt persistence. Telemetry stored minimal and hashed embeddings stored per contract. Retention windows will be specified.
maddie: Ops-bot, please provision a staging tenant "omniship-demo" with 10-day TTL.
ops-bot: Provisioning tenant... done. id: demo-omniship-2955. Creds shared.
elena: Pricing slide: POC discount 25% off list, PS for SSO & peering (2 eng days).
tom: Cost calc: infra $4,200/day (5 gpus) -> 10 days -> $42k. After 25% discount -> $31.5k. PS $8k. Total $39.5k.
maddie: Add SLA credit clause: if p99 latency breaches, 10% infra credit.
claire: Need a pen-test contact. Raj?
raj: I'll coordinate. No production creds for pen test.
elena: Demo script: ingest 30k tickets, embeddings, reranker. Disk ~30GB, enable batching and quantized embedder.
tom: I'll update infra plan and terraform snippet for peering.
claire: I'll attach SAML cert once thumbprint available.
raj: Uploaded thumbprint to secure notes.
maddie: Goal: send full package (SAML metadata + cert, ISA answers, pricing slide, runbook) by EOD tomorrow.
